title: Bag Part: Embed Content Items Inside a Content Item | Orchard Core
description:
A page often needs a group of related items, such as questions and tips, that belong to that page and nowhere else. Creating each one as a separate content item and linking it to the page adds work for editors.

The Bag part of the Orchard Core Flows module holds content items of the content types you choose inside another content item. Editors add, reorder, and remove them in the page's own editor, and the site displays them with the page.

In this video:
• What a Bag part is, and how it differs from the Flow part
• Adding a Bag to a content type and choosing the content types it holds
• Adding items to a page
• Reordering and removing items
• How the bag is displayed on the site
• The Blocks editor, a dialog for picking a content type
